status: Generating the remaining uppercase and lowercase letters sequentially. New designs require human review; the initial S and refined I are already user-accepted.

referenceImages.role: Original M; the only visual reference. Match its broad rising ribbons, narrower returns, soft asymmetric crests and rounded-flat terminals.

generationPolicy: One letter per call, inspected as an actual saved image before the next generation. Preserve every raw PNG, failed attempt, prompt, event and fingerprint. No pixel cleanup, redrawing, stretching or vector substitutes.

Y.prompt: Image 1 is my ORIGINAL uppercase M and the ONLY visual style reference. Generate exactly ONE new uppercase letter Y, drawn by the same type designer in this heavy organic ribbon font. Preserve the original M's broad rising white ribbons versus narrower returning strokes, soft flowing asymmetric contours, rounded crests, clean rounded-flat terminals and slight forward motion. This must be a full, weighty sibling, not a thin monoline or a generic geometric sans or italic serif. Make an unmistakable printed uppercase Y: two separate cap-height upper arms meet at one smooth central fork, then one broad gently rising stem reaches the baseline. The right rising arm is broad, the left return narrower, and all joins are softly rounded. Keep both upper spaces open. No V-only silhouette, extra stem, counter, serif caps or disconnected pieces. Use a capital-height letter. Draw only the single requested white glyph centered on pure black, with generous empty margins around every terminal, dot and descender. Flat untextured white ink, no color, gradients, shadows, outlines, gloss, 3D, other letters, captions, guides or multiple options. Do not redraw M.

b.prompt: Image 1 is my ORIGINAL uppercase M and the ONLY visual style reference. Generate exactly ONE new lowercase letter b, drawn by the same type designer in this heavy organic ribbon font. Preserve the original M's broad rising white ribbons versus narrower returning strokes, soft flowing asymmetric contours, rounded crests, clean rounded-flat terminals and slight forward motion.
